name: hedwig-desktop
description: HEDWIG desktop shell — Electron main process and development orchestration

scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:node && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck && uv run mypy
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
